outputs: Generated text completions and question answers
The paper evaluates generated outputs in completion and QA tasks using metrics such as AUROC, perplexity, Self-BLEU, and distinct n-grams.

changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Text Summarization' and 'Dialogue Generation' as they are not evaluated tasks in this paper. Simplified outputs to be more precise about what is actually generated.
Normalized metric names to consistent forms and removed duplicates. The paper uses automatic metrics extensively for evaluating watermark detection and text quality.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper focuses on watermark detection using statistical methods, not LLM-based assessment of text quality.
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper. All evaluations are conducted using automatic metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on watermarking techniques for LLM-generated text, specifically evaluating watermark detection performance and text quality/diversity. The main NLG tasks evaluated are text completion and question answering. The paper uses comprehensive automatic metrics but does not employ LLM-as-judge or human evaluations. The extraction was generally accurate but included some tasks that weren't actually evaluated in the paper.
